subject: Endpoint tooling renewal — vendor comparison & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: SecuriScan Procurement <procurement@securiscan.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Endpoint tooling renewal — vendor comparison & next steps

Hi Alya / SecuriScan team,

We're approaching renewal for our endpoint stack (MDM + EDR + vulnerability scanner). I want to make sure we have apples-to-apples figures for budgeting and procurement before the end of the month. Can you send:

- A one-page summary with list/pricing for 12/24-month terms (seat-based + enterprise bundle), including any volume discounts and partner rates.
- Confirmation of SOC 2 Type II status and the latest report (or an ATO packet).
- Details on data retention for endpoint telemetry and mechanisms for customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).
- Any changes in licensing model or minimums compared to our current contract.

Target: consolidate options and recommend negotiation levers by May 26 so we can decide for the June procurement window. I've CC'd Monica (security lead) and Markus (SRE/infra) for technical checks, and Lauren for approval/finance sign-off.

Thanks — please attach proposal and any supporting docs.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none in this message)

From: Alya Torres <alya.torres@securiscan.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SecuriScan Procurement <procurement@securiscan.io>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@securiscan.io>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:32:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Endpoint tooling renewal — vendor comparison & next steps

Hi Karthik / team,

Thanks for the note — appreciated. I've attached our renewal proposal (Securiscan_Renewal_Proposal_2026.pdf) and a short pricing summary. High-level:

- 12-month term: list price $3.25/device/month for EDR, $1.10/device/month for MDM, vulnscanner billed per scan node ($4,200/node/yr).
- 24-month committed term: 12% off list across the bundle; additional 5% for partner program (applies at PO time).
- Flex seat model: we can float a 10% seat buffer at no charge for the first renewal quarter.

On compliance/controls: we are SOC 2 Type II; please find SSAE18_SOC2_TypeII_Securiscan_2025.pdf attached. We support customer KMS integration (AWS KMS + external HSM through our key-wrap API). Telemetry retention: default 13 months; archival available to 36 months for an additional fee.

For technical validation, Samir (our integrations lead) is standing by to run a short POC/health-check with Markus if helpful — cc'ed.

Link to pricing sheet: https://securiscan.io/pricing/redwood-compare (internal link).

Best,
Alya Torres
Enterprise Sales, SecuriScan

Attachments:
- Securiscan_Renewal_Proposal_2026.pdf (pdf, 248KB)
- SSAE18_SOC2_TypeII_Securiscan_2025.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alya Torres <alya.torres@securiscan.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Endpoint tooling renewal — vendor comparison & next steps

Thanks, Alya — quick follow-ups from security side before we move this into procurement: 

- Confirm encryption at-rest for telemetry and whether keys are customer-managed by default or opt-in.
- Does SecuriScan perform live agent memory scraping? We need to verify privacy/data-minimization controls for developer workstations.
- Can you confirm that retention for telemetry search indexes can be limited per-organization (we can't retain raw logs beyond 13 months without a legal justification).

Markus, please coordinate with Samir for a short validation call (30 min).

Alya — if you can respond inline and share any redlines you anticipate in the SOW/Vendor Terms, that'll help speed the review.

Cheers,
Monica
Head of Security, Redwood Inference

On Tue, May 19, 2026 at 11:32 AM Alya Torres <alya.torres@securiscan.io> wrote:
> (see attached proposal + SOC 2)
>

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@securiscan.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alya Torres <alya.torres@securiscan.io>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Endpoint tooling renewal — vendor comparison & next steps

Hi Markus / Monica — happy to set up a call. Quick technical notes that may answer some items before we talk:

- Telemetry at rest is AES-256 encrypted; customers can opt to bring their own KMS keys (we have documented key-wrap flow).
- Agent behavior: our EDR agent does process and memory inspection for threat detection but we provide per-policy toggles to limit memory collection for developer-populated endpoints.
- Retention: search indexes are configurable by tenant; default is 13 months, archival to S3 (encrypted) available to 36 months.

If Markus shares a few candidate times today/Thu we’ll slot in a 30-45 min validation session.

Regards,
Samir
Integrations Lead, SecuriScan

Attachments: vulnscan-performance-summary-2026.csv (csv, 42KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Alya Torres <alya.torres@securiscan.io>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@securiscan.io>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Endpoint tooling renewal — vendor comparison & next steps

Thanks all — summary for procurement packet: 

- SecuriScan proposal: two-term options (12/24 mo) with a baseline 12% discount on 24-month commit + partner 5% at PO. SKU details in attached PDF.
- Tech: AES-256 at rest, KMS integration supported, telemetry retention default 13 months (configurable). Agent memory inspection can be toggled for developer machines.
- Commercial ask: I propose we negotiate the EDR license down to billable seats = 75% of fleet + 10% buffer for spikes, plus aim for an additional 15% one-time concession on first-year billing (partner discount stacked with renewal incentive).

I've put vendor comparison notes and target terms in the procurement sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aB2cVendorCompare

Lauren — can you sign off on the negotiation strategy so I can instruct procurement to present the counter? If anything else you need to escalate (SLA credits, invoice terms), say so and we'll include it in the redline.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: (summary inline, proposal already attached earlier)

Karthik — go ahead and present that counter to SecuriScan with one ask: cap any annual increase to list price +5% for the duration of the term (we can't have step function increases). If SecuriScan agrees to the 75% seat billing and the 15% first-year concession, we approve the negotiation.

Also flag to procurement that we prefer a 12-month PO with an option to convert to a 24-month commitment at the discounted rate after Q1 if we validate performance.

Please confirm when the counter is sent.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
